## What this changes

Brief summary of the change. One or two sentences.

## Why

The reason behind this change. If it fixes an issue, link it: `Fixes #123`.

## How I tested it

- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit` returns zero errors
- [ ] Manually tested the affected feature
- [ ] If it's a UI change, I've attached a screenshot

## Screenshots (if UI change)

Before / after.

## Notes for the reviewer

Anything non-obvious — a design decision, a trade-off, a thing that 
might look wrong but isn't.
